queries.name: o2c_baseline_observations
queries.purpose: Return raw duration samples across the whole O2C graph. The engine groups these rows by baseline_key and calculates count, mean, population standard deviation, Q1, Q3, IQR, and upper fence.
queries.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ev:EVENT {process: $process_type})
  WITH ev.case_id AS source_id, min(ev.event_time) AS start_t, max(ev.event_time) AS end_t
  RETURN source_id,
         'case_age_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'CASE_LEAD_TIME' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(start_t), datetime(end_t)).seconds) AS sample_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
  WHERE o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN o.case_id AS source_id,
         'order_queue_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::ORDER_QUEUE' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) AS sample_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS source_id,
         'fulfillment_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::FULFILLMENT_DWELL' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) AS sample_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS source_id,
         'transit_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::CARRIER_TRANSIT' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) AS sample_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {process: $process_type})
  MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: inv.case_id})
  WHERE inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN inv.case_id AS source_id,
         'billing_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::BILLING_SETTLEMENT' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) AS sample_value
}
WITH *
WHERE sample_value IS NOT NULL
RETURN source_id, metric_name, baseline_key, sample_value

queries.name: o2c_candidate_metrics
queries.purpose: Return the same five duration measurements per case/entity that must be compared against their matching baseline distributions.
queries.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ev:EVENT {process: $process_type})
  WITH ev.case_id AS case_id, min(ev.event_time) AS start_t, max(ev.event_time) AS end_t
  RETURN case_id,
         'CASE' AS scope,
         case_id AS record_id,
         null AS entity_type,
         null AS current_state,
         'case_age_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'CASE_LEAD_TIME' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(start_t), datetime(end_t)).seconds) AS metric_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
  WHERE o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN o.case_id AS case_id,
         'PROCESS_INSTANCE' AS scope,
         o.entity_id AS record_id,
         'ORDER' AS entity_type,
         o.status AS current_state,
         'order_queue_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::ORDER_QUEUE' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) AS metric_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id,
         'PROCESS_INSTANCE' AS scope,
         s.entity_id AS record_id,
         'SHIPMENT' AS entity_type,
         s.status AS current_state,
         'fulfillment_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::FULFILLMENT_DWELL' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) AS metric_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id,
         'PROCESS_INSTANCE' AS scope,
         s.entity_id AS record_id,
         'SHIPMENT' AS entity_type,
         s.status AS current_state,
         'transit_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::CARRIER_TRANSIT' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) AS metric_value

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {process: $process_type})
  MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: inv.case_id})
  WHERE inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN inv.case_id AS case_id,
         'PROCESS_INSTANCE' AS scope,
         inv.entity_id AS record_id,
         'INVOICE' AS entity_type,
         inv.status AS current_state,
         'billing_seconds' AS metric_name,
         'STAGE::BILLING_SETTLEMENT' AS baseline_key,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) AS metric_value
}
WITH *
WHERE metric_value IS NOT NULL
RETURN case_id, scope, record_id, entity_type, current_state, metric_name, baseline_key, metric_value
